_note: Copy this, change the right-hand sides to your column names, pass with --schema. Anything you leave out falls back to the defaults in verdicts.py.
_note_proxies: The ladder, in the order it is reported. Rung order is the order of the keys here. `binary` is documentation only — the same exact paired test is used either way, which is what makes the rungs comparable.
_note_sensitivity: Reported as extra rungs and flagged as sensitivity rows, not as the primary measure. Drop this block entirely to skip them.
_note_controls: Ceiling is the no-eviction control, not the oracle, until the oracle byte-feasibility question is settled. Floor is empty memory, taken per workload. Both are excluded from every pairwise comparison and from every argmax.
_note_prereg: Fix these before looking at anything. They are the numbers that go in the methods section.
